notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
New Update!

[list]
[*] Controllers should now work to play the game (You'll still need a mouse for menu navigation for now)
[*] Rebindable keyboard keys! (New options menu should allow customizable keybinds for controls)
[/list]

I might change the cost of dropping a bomb to 5 instead of 10, more testing required
